To apply for leave:
1. Log in to the **greytHR** portal.
2. Go to **Leave > Leave Apply**.
3. Select the **Leave Type** and dates.
4. Enter a **Reason** and click **Submit**.

To check your leave status:
1. Log in to the **greytHR** portal.
2. Go to **Leave > Leave Information > My Leave**.
3. Look at the **Status** column to see if it is **Pending**, **Approved**, or **Rejected**.

To apply for OD:
1. Log in to the **greytHR** portal.
2. Go to **Attendance > Regularization**.
3. Select the **Date**.
4. Select **On Duty** in the Reason field.
5. Click **Apply**.

patterns: How to get my salary slip
where can i download my payslip
responses:
To download your payslip:
1. Log in to the **greytHR** portal.
2. Navigate to **Salary > Payslips**.
3. Select the **Month**.
4. Click the **Download** icon.

To check your balance:
1. Log in to the **greytHR** portal.
2. Go to **Leave > Balances**.
3. View your **Available**, **Consumed**, and **Granted** leaves.

patterns: Show my total earnings for the year
responses:
To view Year-to-Date earnings:
1. Log in to the **greytHR** portal.
2. Go to **Salary > YTD Reports**.
3. View your **Gross Earnings** and **Deductions** for the current financial year.

patterns: I want to cancel my leave
responses:
To cancel or withdraw a leave:
1. Log in to the **greytHR** portal.
2. Go to **Leave > Leave Information > My Leave**.
3. Find the **Pending** leave application in the list.
4. Click **Withdraw** or **Cancel**.

To view the Holiday List:
1. Log in to **Teamlink**.
2. Navigate to **HR > Policies**.
3. On the left sidebar, click on **02 Holidays 2026**.

To check your logs:
1. Log in to the **greytHR** portal.
2. Navigate to **Attendance > Attendance Info**.
3. Here you can view your **Clock-in/out** timings and **Present/Absent** status.

If your leave page is blank, please report it:
1. Log in to the **Teamlink** portal http://teamlink/Helpdesk/public/en/employee/login .
2. Raise a ticket under **HR Support** > **Portal Issues**.

1. Log in to the **greytHR** portal.

(You can also find this at the bottom of your **Payslip**).

patterns: How many leaves do I get per month?
What is the leave policy for probation?
How many holidays am I allowed to take?
Difference in leaves for probation and permanent
responses:
Your leave entitlement depends on your employment status: 
1. **Permanent Employees**: 2 leaves per month.
2. **Probation & Contract Employees**: 1 leave per month.
